run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T06:39:11Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning on otel-demo/frontend is explained by a configuration regression introduced with the shipping Deployment rollout at 06:37:51Z: the new ReplicaSet's pod template sets QUOTE_ADDR to "quote:0000", which is not a valid URI, whereas the replaced ReplicaSet used "http://quote:8080". shipping's /get-quote handler now fails before any network call (child span "POST " ends in Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))) after 10µs), /get-quote returns 500, checkout PlaceOrder fails with gRPC 13 ("shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500"), and frontend POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500. Frontend error spans start at 06:39:17Z, ~1.5 minutes after the new shipping pod started, and exist only on the checkout path; quote service traffic drops to zero in the same window because the request never leaves shipping. Other services on the checkout path (cart, product-catalog, currency) returned gRPC status 0 in the sampled trace, and no ERROR series exist for quote, email, payment, cart, product-catalog or currency.

claims.text: frontend error spans (status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR") first become non-zero at 06:39:17Z and appear only on the checkout path: span_name POST, "POST /api/checkout", "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" and "grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder". ERROR series for GET, "GET /", "GET /api/cart", "GET /api/data", "GET /api/products/{productId}", "GET /api/recommendations", "POST /api/cart" and all grpc client spans to AdService/CartService/ProductCatalogService/RecommendationService stay at 0 for the whole 05:39:11–06:53:17Z window.

frontend's error-span rate (sum by status_code of rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend"}[5m])) was 0 until the 06:38–06:39 minute, then rose to 1.259/s at 06:43, 2.386/s at 06:46 and 2.326/s at 06:47, versus ~40–46 spans/s for STATUS_CODE_UNSET; at 06:53:11Z the error-span share of all frontend spans was 0.0483.

One complete trace (36e4c651c4ab2372d0ad5f57ced69aa6) shows the failure propagating: load-generator POST (http 500) → frontend-proxy ingress → "router frontend egress" → frontend POST → "POST /api/checkout" → "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" → frontend client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 13, message "shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500") → checkout server span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (same message) → checkout "HTTP POST" (error) → shipping server span "/get-quote" (error, otel.status_description "Internal Server Error", 70µs) → shipping client span "POST " (error, Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat))), 10µs).

In the same trace the other checkout dependencies succeeded: checkout→cart oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, checkout→product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (twice) and checkout→currency oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (twice) all carry rpc.grpc.status_code "0"; no email or payment span appears in the trace, so the order flow did not reach those steps.

shipping error spans repeat the same shape across several traces: server span "/get-quote" fails in 61–70µs with "Internal Server Error", each having a child client span "POST " that fails in 9–10µs with "Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))" — the failure occurs before any network round trip.

Kubernetes events show a shipping Deployment rollout at 06:37:51–06:37:58Z: ScalingReplicaSet scaled new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1, pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn was Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started (container started 06:37:58), the old pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q was killed and old ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 scaled 1→0 with SuccessfulDelete.

Both shipping ReplicaSets use the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping, so the rollout changed configuration only; the new ReplicaSet (created 06:37:51Z) has env QUOTE_ADDR="quote:0000", while the replaced ReplicaSet (created 06:01:20Z, now replicas 0) had env QUOTE_ADDR="http://quote:8080". The shipping Deployment currently reports replicas 1, ready 1, updated 1.

The quote Service is present in namespace otel-demo with ClusterIP 100.69.17.22, port 8080/tcp (name tcp-service, targetPort 8080), and its Endpoints resolve to address 100.96.4.18 on port 8080; the shipping Endpoints resolve to 100.96.3.140:8080.

quote service span volume declined from ~1516 spans in the trailing 846s at 06:39:17Z to 0 at 06:52:17Z and 0 at 06:53:17Z, i.e. no quote spans in 06:39:11–06:53:17Z, consistent with shipping never sending the quote request.

Error spans by service over the whole window: frontend (POST, POST /api/checkout, executing api route /api/checkout, grpc CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) and frontend-proxy (ingress, router frontend egress) start at 06:39:17Z; checkout ("HTTP POST", "oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder") and shipping ("/get-quote", "POST ") start at the 06:40:17Z point; no ERROR series exist for quote, email, payment, cart, product-catalog or currency. Steady flagd EventStream error spans exist in ad (from ~06:28), fraud-detection (from ~06:27) and recommendation (from ~06:14) at ~1–2 per trailing 846s, before the alert and unrelated to the checkout path.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running with restart count 0; every pod except shipping started 06:01:19–06:03:01Z on node i-011f41ab3a4ff99c7, while shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn started 06:37:51Z on node i-00d608019e1b5d480 — the only workload created during the incident window.

shipping container logs for 06:37:51–06:53:17Z contain only normal startup lines ("Successfully configured OTel", "Shipping service is running", actix listening on 0.0.0.0:8080) and repeated "Requesting quote" lines; the request failure is visible only in span status, not in container logs.

Most likely cause: the 06:37:51Z shipping Deployment change set QUOTE_ADDR to "quote:0000", an invalid URI (no scheme, port 0000). shipping's /get-quote therefore fails at URI parsing (http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)), 10µs, no network call), returns HTTP 500, checkout PlaceOrder returns gRPC 13, frontend POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500, and frontend's error-span rate rises from 0 at ~06:39Z — which is the alert's observed signal.

Rejected: the quote service itself failing or being unreachable. quote has no ERROR span series in the window, its Service and Endpoints (100.96.4.18:8080) exist, and its span volume simply falls to 0 after 06:39 because shipping never issues the request (the client span dies at URI parsing in 10µs).

Pod readiness does not clear shipping: shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is Running with restart count 0, the Deployment reports 1 ready replica, and container logs look normal, yet that pod's own /get-quote spans return 500 — the workload is up but functionally failing.

The propagated message text says "failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500", but that text does not make email a failing entity: no email span exists anywhere in the sampled trace, email has no ERROR span series, and the only failing outbound span is the invalid-URI POST inside shipping's /get-quote handler, which is the source of the 500 that checkout reports.

Impact observed so far is limited to the checkout path: frontend POST /api/checkout spans return http.status_code 500 (load-generator POST spans also record 500), while frontend GET routes and grpc calls to ad, cart, product-catalog and recommendation have zero error spans in the window.

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate is not retrievable: list_prometheus_rules returned no_data both with rule_name=RequestErrorRate (8e63dd55-1dff-4ab0-bdee-f265a67b1f5e-t0:f32c06a4-e1ab-4c82-b934-1e599c523490) and with type=alert (0a3e0324-eb5d-40a1-a5ed-1220bba8ea0f-t0:2aa9e70f-574a-43f9-b066-49a40e744cfb), so the rule expression, evaluation window and the meaning of the reported value 1.7777 (rate vs percentage) could not be verified or recomputed from the rule.

Frontend container logs could not be inspected: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-lmznt returned status no_data with 0 bytes / 0 lines for 06:35–06:53:17Z (def7202d-f560-456d-b84f-9253a6e537a4-t1:4b390047-c10b-42bb-a572-99b1016a6d45), so frontend's own log-level error evidence is unknown.

Checkout container logs returned status no_data for 06:35–06:53:17Z (def7202d-f560-456d-b84f-9253a6e537a4-t0:dceee7ca-12b3-4563-944d-9affd86449ed: 952 lines read, 0 shown for the error|fail|500|shipping filter), so checkout log-level errors can be neither confirmed nor excluded.

The shipping error-span read adopted from the oversized trace search is incomplete and truncated (e11f8c85-da41-4fb0-bedd-d1e5fedf5e27-t0:6d7c633c-9600-49c0-a008-a53a16d33c8c, 10 of 113 rows), and the shipping log read stopped at 06:46:52Z (391b1c08-08ba-4843-b484-c2f7ba64e73a-t1:e091a6fc-8f4b-4b2b-9d16-882301c75198, 60 of 333 lines), so later minutes are unobserved.

Change history / audit for the shipping Deployment edit is not integrated (change_history is listed as not_integrated); the QUOTE_ADDR difference is observed by comparing the two live ReplicaSet pod templates, not from an audit trail of who or what changed the value.
Whether the quote service would answer correctly on http://quote:8080 now is unverified: quote received no spans after ~06:39Z, so its post-change behavior is unobserved.
Payment and email behavior after the failed quote step is unknown: checkout aborts before those calls, so only the absence of their ERROR span series is observed.
next_steps: Restore shipping's QUOTE_ADDR to the previously working value "http://quote:8080" (matching the replaced ReplicaSet and the quote Service port 8080) and roll the Deployment, then confirm shipping /get-quote spans stop carrying error status and quote spans resume.

Review how "quote:0000" entered the shipping Deployment pod template (manifest/CI source of truth) and add a pre-deploy validation that the value parses as a URI with scheme and valid port, since the application only fails at request time and stays Ready.
Once shipping can reach quote, spot-check that checkout PlaceOrder and frontend POST /api/checkout return success and that frontend's status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR" rate returns to 0.
